responsibilities.name: Fleet Health Check & Auto-Status Sync
responsibilities.instruction: Check the health, compliance, and status of all fleet agents. Verify that all VMs are online and in correct OUs, and compile a fleet status report.

context.purpose: Ensure the fleet is healthy and compliant, and detect any offline VMs or stuck agents immediately.
process: Run fleet-status --json to list all registered fleet agents and their states
For any agent that is 'online', review its health attributes and compliance records (e.g. ouCompliant)
If any agent is offline or has actionRequired, identify the blocker
Synthesize a fleet health report summarizing active fleet size, online agents, compliance status, and any active actionRequired blocks.
context.success_criteria: A synthesized fleet health report is generated detailing the status of all registered fleet agents.
context.prior_learnings: Do not attempt to modify fleet VMs directly during a status check. If action is required, document it in the synthesis so the operator or Prime's dispatch can address it.
